name: Sync-NeRF Offset Optimization
aliases: Per-camera Time Offset with Dynamic NeRF
definition: A method to handle unsynchronized multi-view videos by introducing per-camera time offsets t_k and jointly optimizing these offsets along with the NeRF parameters using a reconstruction loss.
summary: Sync-NeRF Offset Optimization reconstructs dynamic scenes from unsynchronized multi-view videos by jointly optimizing per-camera time shifts alongside neural radiance field parameters.
